runtime_formula: light = albedo * (scale_s*lm_static + scale_t*mod_troffer(t,s)*lm_troffer + scale_v*mod_tv_rgb(t,s)*lm_tv + scale_b*mod_beacon(t,s)*lm_beacon); modulators from control_room_runtime_behaviour.json

verification.method: Low tier emulated in Blender (every surface = albedo x the four lightmaps, no lights), same four cameras and settings as the path-traced renders, frame 1, stability 1
verification.lost_vs_path_traced: real-time specular, contact grain/grime, window glass sheen, shadow sharpness limited to about 48 texels/m
verification.gain_note: a lightmap gain of about 1.2 would match mean brightness; NOT render-verified

noise_filter: indirect sample clamp 8, firefly clamp at 1.5x the 99.7th percentile, coverage-aware gaussian sigma 1.6 texels
